fq-note.text: Lowrance Active Imaging HD 3-in-1 (Medium/High). Frequencies from Lowrance's product page for the Medium/High version: Medium and High CHIRP (83/200 kHz), DownScan 700/1200 kHz and SideScan 455/1075 kHz; the installation manual lists all four DownScan and SideScan frequencies as CHIRP. Lowrance publishes no beam angles. 2D is a forum estimate; the DownScan angles are estimates scaled by wavelength from a dealer's 45° at 800 kHz (a figure identical to Humminbird's published Down Imaging one); SideScan 1075 kHz is 455 kHz scaled the same way. Widths and edge errors are at your depth.
